status: provisional (fit + valid evidence; awaiting hand-label confirmation)
replaces: v1, kept for the record in config/emotion_spec_v1.json
reason: Reduce the neutral share with a pre-declared rule (D30) and re-select features on the new weighting (D32)

labelling.rule: 6-class group of the max raw score over the 27 non-neutral labels if >= t, else neutral
labelling.use: reporting and validation only; never a model feature
labelling.caution: A low t reduces neutral by definition; 75.0% of items labelled emotional have a classifier neutral score above 0.5. Hand labels are the real test.

fusion.normalisation: per-impression min-max of base and emotion scores

excluded.cong_valence_absdist: sign flips on valid (fit dz -0.026, valid dz +0.037)

excluded.cong_*_otheruser / cong_*_userspecific: analysis controls (random other user), not model features

confirmation_rule.run: python scripts/06_validate_emotion_labels.py (after 180 labels; re-label sheet optional)
confirmation_rule.title_primary_if: goemotions_title kappa CI lower bound > goemotions_v2 kappa CI upper bound
confirmation_rule.revert_if: goemotions_v2 kappa CI upper bound < goemotions_weighted kappa CI lower bound
confirmation_rule.hold_if: intra-rater kappa CI upper bound < 0.4 (labels too unreliable to act on)
confirmation_rule.otherwise: confirm v2 (only 'status' changes; hashed content unchanged)
confirmation_rule.not_validated_by_labels: continuous go_pct_*, go_vad_*, go_dist_*, vad_valence: the 6-class labels do not test them directly; they stay unless a source rule above removes them
confirmation_rule.any_change: new file config/emotion_spec_v3.json + decision log entry + test hash entry
